_comment: The leveraged trend strategy's live settings (docs/LEVERAGE_STRATEGY.md). maintenance_margin: the share of your exposure your broker requires as equity before a margin call. 0.25 is the usual minimum for a margin loan on an index fund; S&P 500 futures need far less (about 0.06-0.08). Set it to your broker's actual figure. No account details belong here: this repository is public.

multi_asset._comment: MA, the multi-asset trend portfolio (docs/LEVERAGE_STRATEGY.md), chosen 2026-10-10 at L2's volatility. maintenance_margin: futures margin as a share of gross exposure; 0.08 is a conservative blend of equity, Treasury and gold futures. Set it to your broker's figure.
